title: metica_assignment
description: Value of the Firebase Remote Config parameter metica_assignment (value type JSON, parameter group "Metica"). One rule cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and is enforced by the library and the setup script: the last '-' segment of experiment_id, read as a percentage, must equal metica_percentage (compared in basis points). A value that breaks any rule is ignored by the client, which keeps its cached or baked config. Unknown extra fields are allowed and ignored. Breaking changes are published under a new parameter name (metica_assignment_v2).

experiment_id.description: Format <studio>_<game>-<datestamp>-<metica_percentage>. Game segment: <studio>_<game>, lower case [a-z0-9._], 1-64 chars, no '-'. Datestamp: a real UTC calendar date YYYYMMDD. Percentage segment: canonical form (no leading zeros, no trailing decimal zeros, at most 2 decimals) and equal to metica_percentage. Also the hash salt, so one id always means one percentage and is never reused with another.

metica_percentage.description: Share of devices assigned to the Metica group under this experiment_id, 0-100, at most 2 decimals. Changing it means publishing a new experiment_id.

enabled.description: Kill switch. false: from each device's next session after it caches the value, no device routes ads to Metica. The assigned group and labels do not change. May change under the same experiment_id.
